profile.navigation: isolated context per sample; focus intent, 400 ms dwell, article activation, history.back()

covers: React, Next runtime, and Flight scripts are absent from hybrid documents
manual gzip, Vary, and 60-second content cache policy
escaped and ranked fallback search output

manualInteractionChecks.observation: Five initial requests: document, font, stylesheet, bootstrap, and favicon; neither the search module nor search index was requested.

Search intent added only search.js and the unchanged search index, opened a native dialog, returned ranked results, and returned focus after Escape cleared the native search field and a second Escape closed the dialog.
The server-rendered search route returned ranked, escaped HTML with a noindex directive.
The native dialog opened, closed on Escape, and returned focus to its trigger.
The form was absent at initial load, inserted near the viewport, and the fixture endpoint returned the visible confirmation 'Thank you!'.
System preference and the stored theme value applied the expected dark document class and body appearance.
The current production article exposes a hydrated Scroll To Comment control without a #comment target; the hybrid contract does not preserve this observed no-op.

backNavigation.method: Five rotating, interleaved samples per architecture. The source article link was focused, the focus-induced scroll was allowed to settle, intent dwell lasted 400 ms, the destination was activated, and history.back() returned to the source.
backNavigation.interpretation: Both paths preserved URL and scroll behavior. The static document path was restored from the back/forward cache in every sampled return. The Next route uses client history, so absence of a document pageshow event is not itself a failure. Neither path restored focus to the source link.

discardedProbe.reason: The first five-run scroll probe read scrollY in the same task as focus(), before the focus-induced scroll settled.
discardedProbe.symptom: It incorrectly recorded source scrollY as zero while every return landed near 2967 px.
discardedProbe.resolution: Wait for the scroll to settle before recording the source position; rerun all ten cases in rotating interleaved order.

limitations: The interaction checks are local fixture evidence, not production field telemetry.
The back/forward-cache sample proves observed eligibility in this Chromium setup, not universal eligibility across browsers or future page features.
No timing result is inferred from the back-navigation behavior check.
